question: What physical rejuvenation results from the flooding of the lower wheel?
premises: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair
One becomes devoid of all disease
inference: This meditation removes signs of aging and all diseases.
uncertainties: The gender/case agreement between valīpalitanirmuktaḥ and sarvavyādhivivarjitam is irregular in the transmitted text.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
